d:
Jam Ouji deserves better than MTL, but since they're probably not going to get it, here's one of their Saint Seiya works from a native English speaker who can (hopefully) give at least a little proofreading (and use an AI model that doesn't spit out indecipherable gibberish).

I'm not normally a fan of scat (put lightly), but for some reason, Jam Ouji's work hits different. I'd like to get more of their stuff into English. Anyway, uh, enjoy?

Support the artist if you can: https://www.pixiv.net/en/users/1598076
n: [Doujinshi] (C68) [Jam Kingdom (Jam Ouji)] Megami-tachi no Gosui (Saint Seiya) [English]
